programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Amanda quiere emanciparse para casarse con un hombre mucho mayor que ella e inválido, su padre se opone. También, Michelle se enamora de Alex y lo trae a Estados Unidos, ella sospecha algo.
programme.sub-title: Inválido caliente / Los 40's son los nuevos 20's

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alexandra y José tuvieron una hija de adolescentes y la dieron en adopción. Ahora José quiere casarse con ella. Además, Miguel pide la custodia de su hijastra porque el papá es un delincuente.
programme.sub-title: Línea de sangre / Sedada como elefante

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniela se hizo varias fotos en los monumentos al Holocausto, pero alteraron sus imágenes. También, Anthony recibió fotografías de su hija muerta y, por los nervios, tuvo un accidente.
programme.sub-title: Turista hostil / El reto de la muerte

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Katy es madre, su suegra la acusa de ser pandillera y quiere la custodia del niño. Sara y su esposo adoptaron a Mariana, su padre biológico salió de la cárcel y Sara desea que se vaya con él.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marcos y Gabriela contratan un vientre de alquiler, pero notan que la gestora de la criatura no está bien de salud. Luis se casa con Edith para que lo reclame legalmente, pero ella se demora.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jéssica sufre de anorgasmia y buscó ayuda en Cornelio, que ofrece servicios cuestionables de meditación orgásmica. Ángel y Patricia se separaron y ambos reclaman ser dueños de una coreografía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniela acordó tener sexo con dos chicos con la condición de que se pusieran condón, pero ellos no cumplieron. Jonathan perdió el puente de dientes postizos en una clase de buceo y exige pago.
programme.sub-title: Violada por un condón / Luna de hielo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Le dio permiso a una amiga para salir con su hijo de 15 años, ella lo violó. También, Pedro es alérgico a la radiación electromagnética del WiFi, por eso usa un inhibidor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Manolo dejó a su hija en Cuba, durante años no se ocupó de ella y ahora la buscó por interés. Además, los hijos de Jorge son menores de edad, pero los obliga a salir con mujeres mayores.
programme.sub-title: Uno por otro / Menores con novia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Concibieron otro hijo para que le donara la médula a su hija con leucemia, pero la niña muere antes. Además, Jakeline es adicta a la tecnología y por consecuencia su hijo de 4 años también.
programme.sub-title: El embrión es un remedio / Combatiendo a la tecnología

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hermano de Víctor se suicidó, porque su novia publicó un video en el que anunció que se quitaría la vida. En otro caso, Bárbara no tiene papeles, estaba en el barco de Bilys y la deportaron.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Claudia y Patricia vivían en trío en un motorhome con el hermano de Ricardo, el chico murió. También, Diego vive con Néstor, un "dreamer" sin papeles, a quien siempre discrimina e insulta.
programme.sub-title: El que se raja pierde / American First

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana quiere tener relaciones sexuales con su esposo Juan, pero este se niega porque teme por la salud de ella. Además, Maxula le entregó su hijo a Anahis pero le devolvieron otro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una jovencita apareció muerta junto a su novio en un motel de paso. Por otro lado, Yolanda tiene problemas con su esposo y contrata los servicios de una cocinera para provocarlo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Eduardo tiene una casa, en su país, que alquilaba a sus hermanos; estos vendieron la propiedad varias veces. También, Ulises tiene una cafetería que está a punto de quebrar por su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Rafael perdió una pierna defendiendo a su suegra Sonia, ella le compró una prótesis y ahora se la quita. Juan es torero y le enseña a sus hijos esta peligrosa profesión, su esposa se opone.
programme.sub-title: La pata de la discordia / El torerito

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Batallas de custodia
programme.desc: Erin investiga el caso de un policía acusado de matar a un sospechoso detenido. Frank le aconseja ceñirse a los hechos para evitar un escándalo. Mientras, Jamie insta a Eddie a perdonarla.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Más allá de todo
programme.desc: Un detective del distrito de Danny es asesinado mientras trabajaba encubierto. Frank busca al asesino, pero descubre un gran secreto del fallecido. Mientras, Jamie y Eddie ayudan a Nicky a encontrar a un excompañero de clase.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Exilio
programme.desc: Cuando Danny es asignado a servicio modificado tras investigar un caso prohibido, se da cuenta de que tropezó con algo secreto. Al pasarle la pista a su padre, Frank se alarma.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: La UAC viaja a Arizona a investigar una serie de crímenes metódicos ocurridos a mujeres, el final es desconcertante. Dentro del equipo también se vive incertidumbre porque Hotch puede ser el remplazo de Strauss quien murió en la temporada pasada.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: La UAC sigue en Arizona investigando acerca de la vida familiar del sospechoso, el cual tenía un gemelo idéntico, pero la madre nunca se lo dijo a la policía.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Cuando un francotirador dispara en Dallas, la BAU investiga si el próximo aniversario del asesinato de Kennedy es un factor de motivación, pero descubrirán que en realidad va a matar la mujer de quien lo contrato.

programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: La UAC conoce a su nuevo jefe, Mateo Cruz, un antiguo conocido de JJ. Cruz se une al equipo mientras peinan las calles de Baltimore en busca de un sospechoso que deja a las víctimas incapaces de comunicarse.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs y el equipo son llamados cuando un par de niños tropiezan con el cuerpo de un marine desaparecido en un lago helado. Mientras el equipo busca pistas en el lecho helado del lago, se topan con otros tres cadáveres acribillados a balazos.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs y su equipo son llamados cuando una criptógrafa del Pentágono sospechosa de espionaje aparentemente se suicida. Con su principal sospechoso muerto, el equipo del NCIS debe descubrir si era o no el topo del Pentágono.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que la escena de un espeluznante asesinato había sido montada, el equipo se da cuenta de que Abby era el objetivo previsto cuando unas pruebas clave contaminan su laboratorio y casi la matan.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Ziva queda en estado de shock cuando una táctica rutinaria que utiliza para someter a un sospechoso podría ser la causa de su repentina muerte. Mientras Ducky y Abby trabajan para limpiar el nombre de Ziva.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Arreglos secretos

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.desc: Martin llega a Bogotá y se aloja en el hotel asignado por Fernando. Por otro lado, todos en el bar se llevan una gran sorpresa al ver que Rosario y Emiliano se han reconciliado. El coloso pierde el control y enfrenta a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Qué bonito amor. Emiliano y Rosario disfrutan de su segunda noche juntos. Mientras tanto, Raquel espera impaciente a Rosario en casa. Por otro lado, Leticia es atracada en la calle y debe recurrir a Fernando para que la ayude.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Todo está listo para el encuentro entre Emiliano y Martin. Emiliano quedará derrumbado y perderá el control al conocer toda la verdad a boca de su cuñado. Emiliano le dará indicaciones a Martin para poder arreglar la situación en la que está.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Leandro reacciona mal luego de haber pasado la noche con Clementina. Clementina se siente culpable y rompe su compromiso con Pepe. Matilde decide ir a buscar a Leandro y ambos aclaran el malentendido. Rodrigo le pide a Pello que lo ayude a vengarse.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Con ayuda de Pello, Rodrigo sorprende a Miriam y Arturo. Rodrigo los amarra a todos, incluyendo a Pello. Arturo escapa y va por la policía. Momentos después, Miriam se rinde y decide irse con Rodrigo. Leandro y Matilde encaran a Hugues y a Moisés.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Clementina le revela a Leandro que está embarazada y él le ofrece criar juntos a su hijo, pero ella se niega. Matilde se entera del estado de salud de Remedios y busca a Leandro para llevarlo con ella.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: A pesar de las súplicas, Matilde termina su relación con Leandro. Moisés intenta acercarse de nuevo a Matilde, pero ella lo rechaza y queda resentido. Leandro le propone a Clementina formar una familia.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Leandro convence a Reinaldo de viajar con él para grabar la última canción del disco. Al regresar, Leandro pide a Dios por su hijo ante la amenaza de que nazca ciego. Se estrena el disco de Leandro y Clementina da a luz.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano le pide a Rosario que aclaren lo que paso entre ellos y la invita a la pensión. Por otro lado, Javier Macías decide irse de su casa por el escándalo que hizo Nora. La oferta laboral que había conseguido Javier para Rosario ha sido cancelada.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Al enterarse que Rosario perdió un examen, Emiliano decide hablar con Raquel y le confiesa lo que paso con Macías. Por otro lado, Macías llega al Bar Garibaldi a disculparse e intenta pagar la serenata pero los mariachis lo echan sin recibir nada.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Gracias a Rosario, Emiliano logra superar la prueba del coloso en tarima. Tras salir del bar, Fernando convence a Emiliano de ir a una comisaría y poner un denuncio por perdida de documentos. Por otro lado, Martin y Steve salen de la cárcel.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Tras salir de la cárcel, Steve y Martin se van a celebrar al apartamento de Corona donde se encuentran con Cristina. Por otro lado, Virginia y sus amigas planean contratar una serenata con el grupo de mariachis para hacerle otra encerrona a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los mariachis llegan a dar la serenata y se sorprenden al ver que fue contratada por Virginia. Mientras tanto, Rosario busca a Sigifredo para informarle que su hija va a dar a luz. Rosario se llevará una gran sorpresa al ver a Virginia con Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo recibe a su nieta en el hospital junto a su esposa y Rosario. Por otro lado, Raquel no para de recordar a Pedro mientras ve a Emiliano sentado en el andén esperando a Rosario y vestido con el mismo traje que era de él.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Descubren que Diomedes tiene el síndrome de guillan barre. Debido a su rara enfermedad quiere estar sus últimos días en Valledupar. La familia lo complace y Betsy le hace terapias con besos y caricias.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Lucia y sus hijos visitan a Diomedes, le dan ánimo para que se recupere, Betsy se molesta al ver la imagen familiar. Lucia, habla con Elvira quien trata de calmarle los celos.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: En su casa adecuan un pequeño estudio de grabación, Diomedes empieza a grabar una nueva canción para el siguiente álbum. Diomedes llama a Consuelo y le pide perdón. Diomedes se le acaba el beneficio y decide fugarse.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: El cacique es obligado por pluma blanca a amenizarle las fiestas en la casa. Betsy visita a Diomedes donde pluma blanca. Le cuenta que está embarazada, esta noticia alegra al cacique quien celebra con la gente de la fiesta y le dedica una canción

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes pide al pluma blanca que lo lleve a la fiestas de la Virgen de Carmen y él accede. Diomedes se monta en la tarima y canta a todos. El público toma fotos y videos. Aparece en los noticieros las imágenes de Diomedes en el sitio.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Betsy llega al lugar para estar con Diomedes un rato. Consuelo viaja desde Bogotá a Valledupar para buscar a Diomedes, se encuentra con Yirao y él le dice que Diomedes esta con pluma blanca.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Thomas les pone plazo de un mes a Corona y a Steve para que paguen los cinco millones de dólares que les decomisó la policía. Por otro lado, Daniela y Laura no le devuelven el sombrero a Emiliano, Virginia prefiere entregarle el sombrero a Raquel.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Duelo de rancheras en el escenario del Plaza Garibaldi, Rosario y Emiliano se retan con canciones sin medir las consecuencias. Los juegos de Virginia continúan funcionando para separar a Emiliano de Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo cree que Emiliano debe arreglar las cosas con Rosario por las buenas y es por esto que deciden llevarle una serenata para pedir perdón. Por otro lado, Felipe Romero se hunde con las declaraciones que hace en la audiencia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Javier Macías visita a Raquel para pedirle excusas. Mientras tanto, Lucia sufre un accidente al montar patineta en la calle y debe ser llevada de urgencias a una clínica. Crecen los enfrentamientos entre Emiliano y Javier Macías.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Felipe Romero es condenado a ocho años de cárcel. Por otro lado, Emiliano llega a la clínica para visitar a Lucia y encuentra a Javier Macías con Rosario. Javier sigue encontrando la forma de molestar a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Thomas continúa presionando a Corona para que consiga los cinco millones de dólares que perdieron. Por otro lado, Martin se entera por boca de Cristina que Felipe recibió una condena de ocho años. Martin no podrá combatir su sentido de culpa.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Leandro se propone darle su apellido al bebé, pero Clementina le recuerda que no es posible porque no están casados. Todos celebran el éxito de Leandro con su disco de oro. Arturo y Gerardo evitan encontrarse con Julio Pantoja e inventan una excusa.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Leandro sorprende a Clementina con una nueva canción el día de su boda. Luego, celebran el bautizo del bebé. Arturo pone a Evaristo de su lado. Leandro llega a Pajales con su mujer y su hijo para pasar el año nuevo.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Alfredo Gutiérrez busca a Leandro y le canta Matilde Lina, él pide su permiso para grabarla. Leandro se niega y confiesa que la canción aún es dolorosa. Evaristo se entera de que Arturo no lee ni escribe y se disgusta.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Matilde sigue perturbando los pensamientos de Leandro, pues él aún recuerda su amor. Reinaldo logra que Leandro hable de sus sentimientos y lo aconseja. Leandro toma su consejo y compone una canción que luego quiere desechar.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Clementina encuentra el papel de la canción que Reinaldo guardó y se molesta al leer la letra que compuso Leandro. Ella lo echa de la casa y le exige a Reinaldo que se vaya. Roberto, decidido a conquistar a Matilde organiza una serenata.

programme.title: Leandro

programme.title: Westward the Women
programme.desc: There's a deficit of good, honest women in the West, and Roy Whitman (John McIntire) wants to change that. His solution is to bring a caravan of over 100 mail-order brides from Chicago to California. It will be a long, difficult and dangerous journey for the women. So Whitman hires hardened, cynical Buck Wyatt (Robert Taylor) to be their guide across the inhospitable frontier. But as disaster strikes on the trail, Buck just might discover that these women are stronger than he thinks.

programme.title: Return of the Gunfighter
programme.desc: Ben Wyatt (Robert Taylor) is an aging gunfighter who has grown weary of his lifestyle. But when an old friend, Luis (Rodolfo Hoyos Jr.), asks for help defending his land, Ben can't say no. Unfortunately, he arrives too late, finding Luis and his entire family -- except daughter Anisa (Ana Martín) -- murdered. Ben is determined to get revenge against the killers, and in pursuing them reluctantly enlists the aid a younger gunfighter, Lee Sutton (Chad Everett).

programme.title: The Law and Jake Wade
programme.desc: Bandits Clint Hollister (Richard Widmark) and Jake Wade (Robert Taylor) botch a robbery that ends with Clint imprisoned. Despairing, Jake leaves the loot in an abandoned village and quits crime for good. Now working for the law, Jake helps free his old cohort from jail. Clint doesn't want the treasure to go to waste, however, so he forces Jake and his girlfriend, Peggy (Patricia Owens), to lead him to the stash. But to unearth the money, they'll have to get past dangerous Comanche warriors.

programme.title: Saddle the Wind
programme.desc: Steve Sinclair (Robert Taylor) is a former gunfighter and soldier who left his violent ways behind him after the Civil War. Since then, he has settled down as a rancher in a small Western town. But his easygoing life is turned upside down when his unstable little brother, Tony (John Cassavetes), shows up with his bride-to-be, Joan (Julie London). While Steve has given up his gun-toting ways, Tony has not, and his violent tendencies lead to trouble for the entire town.

programme.title: Thunder Over the Plains
programme.desc: It's the late 1860s, and the U.S. government has yet to reclaim Texas as a state. A group of opportunistic and amoral Northerners head south to claim the territory as their own. Though Texas lawman Capt. Porter (Randolph Scott) believes it's his duty to honor the local leaders, he can't ignore the corruption of the Yankee politicians who are giving him orders. When Confederate veteren Ben (Charles McGraw) is unjustly sentenced to death, Porter decides he has had enough of his new bosses.

programme.title: Westbound
programme.desc: A former Union officer, John Hayes (Randolph Scott) now manages a stagecoach company. However, Clay Putnam (Andrew Duggan), a businessman still loyal to the South, is intent on robbing the coaches operated by Hayes, which transport gold to the North from California. Hoping to heist the treasure as a way to revive the Confederacy, Putnam also has a grudge against Hayes, since his wife, Norma (Virginia Mayo), was once involved with the handsome Union soldier.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Milton Cross, a feudal estate with a church, farms, houses and acres of land, depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton for their livelihoods. But when Sonia Woodley is stabbed in the churchyard two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, Barnaby and Jones investigate, trying to work out who killed her. It soon becomes clear someone took a pair of tailor scissors to do the deed, but who amongst the villagers could have done so, is unclear, and the investigation is complicated, when the pair learn the local Anglican priest, the parish vicar, had received a letter from Sonia. When he himself is killed, the pair believe something in the letter may be key to solving the mystery.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is not convinced about Mayor David Hicks' plans to revive an annual trip to Brighton, suspecting his proposal to buy coastal land there, is rather a fraudulent scheme. programme.title: Midsomer Murders

Barnaby and Jones need to be quick on the draw to track down the murderer, and soon begin to wonder whether a dispute over land was the motive, or something far more sinister, especially when more people are killed, with methods linked to the Wild West.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Barnaby's wife Joyce swerves her car and narrowly misses a shadowy figure in the road - or so she thinks, when later that night a body is discovered in the old cemetery. programme.title: Midsomer Murders

When Barnaby and Jones start investigating the possible drowning, they discover unsavoury connections to the past that could prove lethal 20 years later, especially when someone attempts to kill. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Christian Pieper
programme.desc: Christian Pieper is an award-winning and crowd-pleasing comedian from Beaver Dam, Kentucky, now living in Los Angeles. In just five years as a performer, Christian has quickly earned acclaim for his honest, smart, and welcoming approach to personal material, layering unexpectedly subversive observations on current events, culture, and relationships.A two-time semifinalist in the prestigious Boston Comedy Festival, hes also been featured in the Crossroads Comedy Festival, Burbank Comedy Festival, and other festivals and competitions across the country. Christian has also performed abroad, having done shows for troops and civilians in eight different countries, and was a guest on the Bob & Tom show. He currently hosts and produces Adrenaline, a comedy-challenge show presented regularly at Wiseguys Comedy Club in Salt Lake City and the Hollywood Improv.

programme.title: Chris Voth
programme.desc: Chris Voth is an accomplished comedian, a licensed teacher, and a published author. Voth made his debut late-night television appearance on the Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson. He also appeared in three seasons of NBC's Last Comic Standing and was chosen for the prestigious Great American Comedy Festival. A 15-year comedy veteran, Voth is a past winner of the Denver Comedy Works Competition and has worked with everyone from Dave Chappelle to Larry the Cable Guy to Linda Ronstadt. Voth's first comedy CD titled "Never Mind the Jim J Bullocks, Here's the Chris Voth" is currently available for purchase. Chris currently balances his performance schedule with his full-time high-school teaching career. You can read his short story, "Stand Up and Deliver," published in the Cream City Review Literary Journal. In it, Chris shares the experiences he had when entering the teaching field after years in stand-up comedy.

programme.title: Michael Joiner
programme.desc: Michaelís brand of comedy is, in a word, familiar. Not in the sense that youíve heard it before, but more so that he knows you and you know him. He speaks about the things you are thinking in a way that sounds so much like your inner voice it is astounding. His effortless delivery will resonate with you. Michael is the 1st Place winner of the Hollywood Improv's "FUNNIEST COMIC IN L.A." 2008, and 2010 Christian Music Hall of Fame "COMEDIAN OF THE YEAR" nominee, Joiner has attracted wide praise for his routines that blend a sarcastic edginess with a devotion to clean humor. Joiner has headlined at The LA AREA Improvs, The Funny Bone, The Ice House and other comedy clubs across the country while also performing at colleges and sold out Clean Comedy Concerts nationwide. He's also written for "The Tonight Show With Jay Leno." He has been performing nationwide for over 25 years and is rated one of the nation's funniest Clean Stand-up Comedians. The TV Guide Network calls Michael "One of the funniest, most original, stand up Comedians working today!" In 2006, Michael was one out of only four Comedians chosen worldwide to star in the top selling DVD, "The Clean Stand Up Comedy Tour." Unlike many Comedians who stick to their rehearsed script, Michael's stand up comedy show includes some of the most clever, hilarious improv and audience interaction you will ever experience.

Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.desc: Practicing for the local snow lodge's big snowboard race, Mia has an accident and hurts her ankle. She insists it's no biggie, but when she tries to resume practice, the normally fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! At the local snow lodge's Snowboard Meet, ace snowboarder Mia, trying to raise money for a new Heartlake City animal shelter, enters the fiercest race of all – the Boardercross. Then, while practicing, she has an accident and hurts her ankle. programme.desc: In this episode, Jason Dozier teams up with his longtime friend, Capt. Danny, for an exciting fishing adventure in Tampa Bay. Reuniting on the water for the first time in over a decade, they're looking forward to making memories, enjoying the day, and maybe even reeling in a fresh catch for dinner.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it's bigger than ever. This time, we're in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida's most critical ecosystems. But it's not just about hard work—it's about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don't miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that's where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it's not just fishing — it's full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it's one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.desc: Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.

programme.desc: La odisea del expresidiario de un país dictatorial que queda inmovilizado por falta de papeles en un puente fronterizo.

programme.title: El Pichichi del Barrio
programme.desc: El Pichichi es el entrenador de un equipo de fútbol femenino patrocinado por un narcotraficante ambicioso.

programme.title: Cuentos colorados
programme.desc: Las aventuras ocurren en una casa de citas muy lujosa, pero el dueño no lo confiesa su profesión a su tía.

programme.title: El Triángulo del Crimen
programme.desc: Un hombre sale de la cárcel, busca la ayuda de un viejo amigo y comprende que entre ellos aún existe la rivalidad que inició durante su infancia.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo

programme.title: En Este Mundo en que Vivimos: Los Fernández de Peralvillo
programme.desc: Un joven fracasa como vendedor de artículos domésticos y su hermana cansada de la pobreza se fuga con un delincuente.

programme.title: Agarrando parejo

programme.title: Misterios de la magia negra

programme.title: Una Estrella y Dos Estrellados
programme.desc: Tin Tan quiere ser estrella, pero es rechazado por los directores de cine, no así por la mujer de la que está enamorado.

programme.title: La loca de la casa
programme.desc: Una monja reevalúa su vida y decide renunciar a sus votos para casarse y ayudar a su padre.

programme.title: Una canción a la Virgen
programme.desc: Una mujer y su hija van a una basílica a pedir que su esposo regrese con ellas y la Virgen les concede el milagro.

programme.title: Rififi en el convento
programme.desc: Los integrantes de una pandilla se esconden en un convento, donde uno de ellos, herido, recibe ayuda.

programme.title: Los viejos somos así

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: Examining the state of Europe and the world before the onset of the war in 1914; the emergence of the German Empire creates strains in the international balance of power; divided among Great Britain, France, Germany, Austria-Hungary and Russia.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.sub-title: Towards Crisis in Politics and Culture

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.sub-title: Causes of the War and the July Crisis, 1914

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The hysterical celebration known as the August Madness greets the outbreak of war between the Central Powers (Germany and Austria-Hungary) and the Allies (France, Great Britain and Russia); how widespread this emotional outburst really is.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.sub-title: The Failed Gambles - War Plans Break Down
programme.desc: This lecture follows the unfolding of the German Schlieffen Plan, which envisions quick victory on two fronts; the French Plan XVII aims to recover lost French territories; both attempts are thwarted.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The Western Front soon freezes into static trench warfare and horrific slaughter from attempts to break this deadlock; generals on both sides seek a breakthrough that allows sweeping offensives and glorious cavalry charges; these never materialize.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.sub-title: Life and Death in the Trenches

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: The horrors of Nazi Germany are one hallmark of World War II; pondering how ordinary German citizens find themselves participating in such heinous events; going inside the propaganda machine of Hitler's Germany; seeing how it targets the youth.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: The origins of World War II lie in Asia in 1931; tracing the invasion of 1937 and the Rape of Nanjing; witnessing the events through the eyes of a Chinese soldier and a Japanese journalist, young men who bear witness to the flesh and blood of battle.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: In addition to the story of people, World War II is the story of technology; perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than the tanks Germany uses to barrel across Poland and France in "lightning warfare"; how new technology defeats the old ways of war.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Wartime Warsaw offers a gateway to the darkest events of the war; bearing witness as the city's Jews are rounded up and put in the ghetto, where the specter of disease and starvation always looms; stories from several of the ghetto's inhabitants.
